name: neonplan3d
description: 3D floor plan for Home Assistant: draw your home in the built-in editor (rooms, walls, doors, windows, furniture, roof) and see and control lights, covers, windows, climate, media, sensors and cameras live in a neon 3D view – as a sidebar panel and dashboard card.

paragraphs: by Mastershort – draw your home right inside Home Assistant and control it in a neon 3D view: lights glow in their colours, blinds move, doors and windows open, cameras watch, and the TV shows what is playing. No external tools, no cloud, made for wall tablets.
▶️ Try the online demo – right in your browser, with invented demo data: turn the house, switch lights, open the editor. Nothing to install.
📖 Manual: English · Deutsch (also in this repository: manual.md, anleitung.md)
